Slightly aloof and ever mysterious, their charm and porcelain doll appearance earns them many eager suitors. Oriole's fascination with other's knick-knacks has landed her in trouble on numerous occasions, but Alouette's work at the local paper generally keeps the family's name clean. Can this odd couple continue their troublesome ways or will their luck eventually run out?
households.key: Bird family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Alouette Bird

households.members: Vera Blackburn, Walter Blackburn, Ginger Blackburn
households.caption: If you ask Vera Blackburn about dog obedience she'll bluntly tell you, "There's no such thing as a bad dog, merely a bad owner." It's hard to argue with her approach when you find yourself cut off mid-sentence with a snap of her fingers and a fire in her eyes. The years haven't been kind to her complexion - some say the wrinkles were sealed in place from her harsh demeanor and ever present frown. Those who get to know her though will discover the love she has for her canine companions, and may pick up some useful tricks to use on their own pets along the way.
households.key: Blackburn family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Vera Blackburn

households.members: Chuck Hobble, Johnny Johnson, Shadow Hobble, Freebird Johnson
households.caption: Chuck Hobble has had enough of scrambling to book gigs and spending every night in a different dusty motel room. Bumps, lumps, thrills and spills have all contributed to the aches in his bones. Nobody said the life of a rodeo cowboy would be easy, but settling down as a minor celebrity in a town like Appaloosa has its perks. He moved in with his long time friend Johnny, a Country songwriter who shares the pains of losing a family due to a life on the road. When they aren't busy swapping stories of groupies, they tend to their horses in their now peaceful existence.
households.key: Country Cowpokes household | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Chuck Hobble

households.members: Tate Curley, Esme Curley, Petunia Curley
households.caption: "Dangnabbit, NO this land is not for sale!" - These are the first and last words any politician or businessman will hear when they pay Tate Curley a visit. As a descendant of one of the oldest settlers in town, Tate finds himself sitting on a prime piece of real estate right along Main Street. As outside pressure increased, Tate and Esme became introverted and guarded, building walls to keep unwanted visitors out. If someone could only find a way to break through their gruff exterior, a veritable encyclopedia of the town's history and stories of the old west await.
households.key: Curley family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Tate Curley

households.members: Honey Darnell, Skedaddle Darnell
households.caption: As a fresh face in the midwest, Honey is discovering a whole new meaning to country singing! This talented songbird hit a rut in writing her new album and thought some new scenery would break the block. Southern gentlemen and southern charm have inspired writers for generations, but life in Appaloosa Plains has taken on a style all its own. With things so good, will she become the town's newest permanent resident?
households.key: Darnell family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Honey Darnell

households.members: Shawnee Fox, Cheyenne Fox, Dakota Fox, Unborn baby Fox, Shep Fox, Bramble Fox, Willow Fox
households.caption: As great descendants of the indigenous occupants of Appaloosa, the Fox family respects the land - and their privacy. Having reclaimed a large plot of land down in the flood plain, they prosper from the fertile soil that has built up over multiple generations. Now they run the most prosperous ranch in town and take great pride in their hand built home. They're certainly self-sufficient, but it wouldn't hurt them to broaden their social circle either.
households.name: Fox family
households.key: Fox family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Shawnee Fox

households.members: Hetty Lionheart, Maria Lionheart, Mothball Lionheart, Pickles Lionheart, Muffin Lionheart
households.caption: The townsfolk give Ms. Lionheart a wide birth should they see her approaching. Not that there's a problem with her that anyone can pinpoint per se, but she is a little... shall we say... eccentric. With her colorful leopard print hat and garish feline apron, the local teens have dubbed her "Old Kitty", a name she'd no doubt give them a good drubbing for should it ever be said to her face. As the last remaining member of her family, she lives out her days with her four cats, and that's just the way she likes things.
households.key: Lionheart family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Hetty Lionheart

households.members: Gracie Loveland, Babycakes Loveland
households.caption: Gracie is a free spirit, but she reigns it in for her day job. Don't be mistaken, she loves working with the kids at Crestview School and takes satisfaction from the opportunity to help shape their lives. But is there more to Gracie than meets the eye? When she's not busy grading papers she dreams of a glamorous life in modeling and finding the right man to sweep her off her feet.
households.name: Loveland family
households.key: Loveland family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Gracie Loveland

households.members: Amelia Loveland
households.caption: Amelia is looking for Mr. Right…only he doesn't seem to be looking for her! In a world with so many eligible bachelors why won't any of them look her way?
households.name: Loveland family
households.key: Loveland family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Amelia Loveland

households.members: Felipe Marshall, Kim Marshall, GooGoo Marshall, BaBa Marshall, Oopsie-Daisy Marshall
households.caption: The Marshalls are madly in love, have a beautiful home, and successful careers. What could go wrong? A glossy exterior hides their secret pain - try as they might they've been unable to have a child. Crib, toy box, and highchair sit unused, and so the Marshall's bide their time and mask their emotions by adopting all the pets they can handle. Puppies, kittens, foals - anything they can nurse and cherish, they welcome into their home. Will they one day be able to have the final addition that would make their family complete?
households.connect: Sports, Spice, and Everything Nice household
households.key: Marshall family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Felipe Marshall

households.members: Sofia Martingale, Cruz Martingale, Marney Martingale
households.caption: Sofia felt trapped for years - trapped in a loveless marriage, and trapped in the concrete jungle of the city. She made the decision to take back her life by kicking her husband to the curb, and uprooting her moody teenage son for a fresh start in the country. Flush with cash from the divorce, she purchased a horse to help charm the posh country crowd. Now that she's a cougar on the prowl, will young Cruz be able to adjust to his new family and make friends in a brand new town?
households.key: Martingale family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Sofia Martingale

households.members: Quincy Miller, Jacquie Miller, Maisy Miller, Mozart Miller, Patch Miller
households.caption: The Millers are one of the most well-liked families in all of Appaloosa. They've built a reputation as trustworthy humanitarians with their strong family values and unending generosity. As fate would have it, they live right next door to the Riffins - certainly a bunch that could use a helping hand. As Quincy and Jacquie keep a watchful eye over their young neighbors, will the seemingly innocent Maisy take her own special interest in Calvin Riffin?
households.name: Miller family
households.key: Miller family (Appaloosa Plains) | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Quincy Miller

households.members: Kanoa Parrott, Jazlyn Parrott, Ethan Parrott, Unborn baby Parrott
households.caption: Having moved to the mainland from Hawaii a few years back, the Parrott family seems like an exotic bunch to the country locals. Their troubles are effectively masked by their neighbors believing their mannerisms stem from cultural differences. Kanoa leads a busy life, routinely commuting to the city on business - and perhaps more. Jazlyn however appears to have become meek and downtrodden over the years; can she find the strength to take back her life and come into her own?
households.name: Parrott family
households.connect: Pelly Family, Martingale family, Unfettered with Feathers household
households.key: Parrott family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Kanoa Parrott

households.members: Clementine Parrott, Lucretia Parrott, Ramona Parrott
households.caption: Clementine couldn't believe that she actually agreed to live with her sisters. Her sister Lucretia spends her nights out on the town and her days on the beach, and her sister Ramona can't sit still long enough to find a focus of her own. Even though they're triplets, Clementine can't help but wonder: When will her sisters ever grow up?
households.name: Parrott family
households.key: Parrott family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Clementine Parrott

households.members: Imogen Pelly, Unborn baby Pelly, Pantoufle Pelly
households.caption: Imogen had it all - as a young beauty pageant star she was at home on the stage! The world grew up with her year after teenage year on the hit show "As the PlumBob Turns." And she blossomed into adulthood with a breakout role in "Simsylvania," playing the love interest between two clans of werewolves, oceans apart in Transylvania and Pennsylvania. Alas, her world came crashing down around her as an unexpected pregnancy led to some unfortunately botched plastic surgery. As the heiress to the silver screen, she's remaining incognito in the countryside until all her problems blow over.
households.name: Pelly family
households.key: Pelly family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Imogen Pelly

households.members: Calvin Riffin, Cornell Riffin, Chantrelle Riffin, Ditz Riffin
households.caption: "The Riffin family - what's left of them that is - has suffered through extraordinary hardship. Clement and Clarissa were loving parents, living off the sweat of their brow and working the land until an unfortunate farming accident left the children orphaned at a young age. As the oldest, Calvin quickly shouldered the responsibility of holding the family together. With their parents watching over them from beyond, and some helping hands from the townsfolk, the Riffins endure and move on.
households.key: Riffin family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Calvin Riffin

households.members: Benjamin Schmidt, Ralston Schmidt
households.caption: Benjamin - handyman by day, eligible bachelor by night. He lives alone with his pup Ralston, but by no means is he lonely. The women of Appaloosa appreciate his skills and there's nothing subtle about the number of house calls he makes for "broken" appliances. Will he ever find a reason to settle down?
households.key: Schmidt family | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Benjamin Schmidt

households.page: Sports, Spice, and Everything Nice household
households.members: Barrington Diamond, Juanita Blanco, Unborn baby Blanco
households.caption: Barrington and Juanita fell madly in love in a whirlwind romance that swept through the town of Appaloosa like a twister speeding across the plains. Juanita was visiting home after her big win on the reality cooking competition Dishes to Delicacy, a show that takes minimum wage dishwashers and turns them into master chefs. She immediately caught the eye of Barrington, the high school coach turned administrator of Appaloosa's new world class stadium. These two rags to riches stories simply clicked, and with the expected pitter patter of tiny feet, it can't be too long before wedding bells chime throughout the town!
households.key: Sports, Spice, and Everything Nice household | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Barrington Diamond

households.members: Benni Hennessey, Zac Whipsnake, Hailey Shepherd, Kenji Midden
households.caption: This eclectic group has decided to pool money together to rent their own home on the range. They come from all walks of life... Benni is the southern belle with modern flair. Zac is the local bad boy - line cook by day and biker by night. Hailey is the typical girl next door who wants nothing more than a pup to call her own. Kenji is the junior archeologist who can't wait to get a closer look at the dinosaur dig on the edge of town. The one thing they all share is a love of animals, but the landlord has a very firm policy of no fur allowed. Until they can change his mind, it looks like they're stuck with a feathered friend.
households.key: Unfettered with Feathers household | The Sims 3: Pets | Appaloosa Plains | Benni Hennessey

households.members: Bryce Savage, Courtney Foster, Seth Monroe, Holly Robins
households.caption: These two couples are just as likely to make it as they are to the end in a bitter breakup. Bryce and Holly are longtime friends who have just moved in with their significant others. Holly only knows her boyfriend from the internet, and Bryce's girlfriend has a reluctance to enter a serious relationship. Will the pair of couples last, or will their relationships end before they've really started?
households.name: A Couple Couples
households.key: A Couple Couples household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Bryce Savage

households.members: Lanya Avilla, Lindy Avilla
households.caption: Even though they are supposed to be identical, Lindy's and Lanya's differences are extreme. Lanya enjoys a quiet night in with a good book, and Lindy hopes to impress the local talent scout to kick start her music career. Can these two continue to share a house, or will their differences force them to part ways?
households.key: Avilla family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Lanya Avilla

households.members: Paul Best, Evan Best, Catherine Best, Calvin Best, Mandy Best, Abigail Best, Maria Best, Unborn baby Best
households.caption: The polar opposite of the Gooders, The Best family is a progressive group of Sims that know that the only way to success is through hard work. After a divorce between Paul and his wife, their son Evan and his family moved to fill in the large house with his growing family. Can the family stay close knit as the children grow up and Evan works a dangerous job that keeps that keeps him away from home? and what will happen when the family discovers the new relationship between Calvin and Natasha Gooder?
households.name: Best family
households.key: Best family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Paul Best

households.members: Karen Kerman, Kerry Kasmir
households.caption: Kerry and Karen are friends who've grown up together have never been separated. They have identical tastes and traits and are easily mistaken for sisters. These two Sims are young and aren't quite sure what they want out of life...But for now, they're content to spend their time getting tans on the beach and having picnics in the park. Can these two find their way, or will they spend their lives drifting aimlessly?
households.key: Best Friends Forever household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Karen Kerman

households.members: Madeline Buckshot, Finnegan Sawyer
households.caption: The perfect celebrity marriage gone wrong, Madeline kicked her famous singer husband to the pool house and now lives with her new love interest, Finnegan. Does Finnegan truly love Madeline, or is he using her for a nice place to live and leg up in his singing career? Was Madeline being too hasty in kicking her former husband to the curb?
households.key: Buckshot household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Madeline Buckshot

households.members: Mimi Olivia, Richter Steele, Willard Wright, Becky Lack
households.caption: A mishmash of Sims from all walks of life, this group isn't for the faint of heart. Between a great cook, runaway teen, wannabe writer, and muscly health nut, everyone in this household miraculously gets along for now. What will the future hold for this diverse group of Sims trying to make it in the city?
households.key: Crash Pad household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Mimi Olivia

households.members: Rich Richmond, Sadie Mason, Mercedes May
households.caption: Rich and Sadie are a happy couple who invited their friend Mercedes to move in with them. The original plan was for Sadie to help Mercedes jump start her Singing career, but now Sadie is worried Mercedes is garnering her fame. Worst yet, Mercedes has taken a liking to Sadie's boyfriend Rich as well. Did Sadie make a mistake in inviting Mercedes into her home, or will Mercedes attempts to steal both Sadie's boyfriend and fans fall flat?
households.key: Dueling Singers household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Rich Richmond

households.members: Craig Elson, Emily Elson
households.caption: Craig and Emily are high school sweethearts who just got married and are excited to spend their lives together! Recent transplants to the city after Emily's job transfer, these two show aficionados are itching to make the most of the star-studded town. Will the distractions of the town over whelm these two newlyweds, or will they settle down and start a family as they'd planned?
households.key: Elson family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Craig Elson

households.members: Edward Gooder, Annabel Gooder, Natasha Gooder, Sebastian Gooder
households.caption: Prim, proper and absolutely high-society, the Gooders are old money Sims that despise the Best family next door and their nouveau riche ways. Edward and Annabel prefer to keep to themselves rather that associate with "unsavory" people. Natasha, however, clearly does not feel this way and is secretly dating Calvin Best. Will her parents come to terms with Natasha's love for Calvin?
households.key: Gooder family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Edward Gooder

households.members: Mithun Khan, Ariella Chen, Ernesto Gonzalez
households.caption: Mithun and Ariella's relationship was great until they gained a permanent houseguest in the form of Mithun's friend Ernesto. The guys have been close their whole lives, but Ariella views Ernesto as a mooch and wants him out! With Mithun's reluctance to ask Ernesto to leave, will Ariella and Mithun continue their happy relationship?
households.key: Khan household | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Mithun Khan

households.members: Mitch Lee, Sonoko Lee
households.caption: Sonoko is a realist, and Mitch likes to dream big. Sonoko lacks confidence in her husband's ambition to make a living as a DJ and is convinced it won't last long. Is she right or will Mitch prevail in his dream to spin the vinyl?
households.key: Lee family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Mitch Lee

households.members: Chad Luck, Isaac Luck, Wylie Luck
households.caption: Three very different brothers just inherited their great aunt's estate and are once reunited under one roof. Each brother followed his own path in life, One brother is now a thrilling Acrobat, another is a hard working Band Manager, and the third is a smooth talker who managed to get by on his looks alone. Will this diverse set of brothers bond together, or will their differences get the best of them?
households.key: Luck family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Chad Luck

households.members: Wayne Martin, Aurora Martin, Nigel Martin
households.caption: A celebrity chef, beautiful wife, and a charming son, the Martins are the envy of many Sims. Really, the only thing this perfect family has to complain about is Wayne's love of fishing, which his wife and son can't seem to understand.
households.name: Martin family
households.key: Martin family (Starlight Shores) | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Wayne Martin

households.members: Danielle Platt, Alora Platt, Robbie Platt
households.caption: The Platt household consists of two adorable children and mother who loves them. Danielle wishes the best, but things can get out of control at times as she struggles to pay the bills and raise two youngsters. Can the Platts stay afloat on Danielle's limited income?
households.key: Platt family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Danielle Platt

households.members: Rehman Sagar, Talan Sagar
households.caption: A single father who wants to see his kid succeed, Rehman pushes Talan to get good grades and to have a real career. But Talan aspires to be on stage as a hot shot performer. Will Talan achieve his of performing, or is he bound to drift away from his father?
households.key: Sagar family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Rehman Sagar

households.members: Matias Singh, Priscilla Singh
households.caption: Matias and Priscilla have been down on their luck recently, but they are both optimistic that life in a new town can turn things around. Priscilla hopes to be a big time Magician and set the world ablaze with fancy tricks, and Matias has a beautiful voice (if only he can be discovered.) Will the Singh family reach stardom, or are they headed straight to the poor house?
households.name: Singh family
households.key: Singh family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Matias Singh

households.members: Navita Singh, Param Singh
households.caption: The Singhs met in medical school and quickly found themselves swept up in a fairytale romance... But this is a fairytale with a twist! On their wedding night, Param was surprised when his new bride Navita suddenly turned into werewolf and turned him into one too! Will the Singhs live wolfally ever after? Or will Param be haunted by his carefree days as a bachelor (and a human)?
households.name: Singh family
households.key: Singh family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Navita Singh

households.members: Jamar Whitfield, Diane Whitfield, Barry Whitfield, Lela Whitfield
households.caption: The Whitfields are the quintessential showbiz family. On the surface they may seem to have fame, fortune and talent, but a life in the entertainment world isn't always glamorous. Will this family's need to be in the spotlight put a strain on their relationships?
households.key: Whitfield family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Jamar Whitfield

households.members: Brandon Woods, Stardust Woods, August Woods
households.caption: The Woods aren't always the most popular family on the block. This isn't because they love trees, but they don't want the city to expand (and protest anything that will cause an urban sprawl). Longtime residents support their cause but performers and proprietors feel differently. Will the Woods succeed in saving the town, or will they further outcast themselves from the community?
households.key: Woods family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Brandon Woods

households.members: Melanie Worthington, Girbits Worthington, Laurel Worthington
households.caption: A sweet grandmother and a kid who can't remember his own name, the Worthingtons lead very different social lives. Melanie loves to entertain friends, while Girbits stays locked in his room playing video games. Will Girbits ever get that first kiss, or will he forever stay single?
households.key: Worthington family | The Sims 3: Showtime | Starlight Shores | Melanie Worthington

households.members: Carl Abbot, Maya Abbot
households.caption: Carl Abbot is not too happy about being stationed in this secluded little town, but his wife thinks it will be good for them.
households.key: Abbot family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Carl Abbot

households.members: Patty Abe, Serena Abe
households.caption: These two sisters are exact opposites, but in some ways balance each other out. Hopefully they can learn to deal with their differences in a civilized manner.
households.key: Abe family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Patty Abe

households.members: Iris Adams, Alastair Adams, Milton Adams
households.caption: With a hefty divorce settlement in tow, Iris Adams is in search of closure and a fresh start for her and her two sons, Alastair and Milton. Alastair is finally coming into his own with music and a teen romance, but Milton seems stuck in his shell. Can this family recover and rebuild?
households.key: Adams family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Iris Adams

households.members: Simon Adamsson, Ericka Berge, Unborn baby Berge
households.caption: Ericka's race to be mayor of Aurora Skies was hard fought and hard won. She's enjoying the high life with the love of her life and business mogul Simon, but life at the top isn't easy. With a surprise baby on the way, will their lives be all the better or will they start to topple?
households.key: Adamsson household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Simon Adamsson

households.members: Diego Almeria, Adora Almeria, Marta Almeria
households.caption: Adora and Diego Almeria came to town looking for a fresh start. They've always had trouble fitting in, but want more for their perfect baby girl Marta. Can Marta's bright future compete with her parent's awkward past?
households.key: Almeria family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Diego Almeria

households.members: Ryan Anderson
households.caption: Ryan Anderson, nature photographer, hopes catching the magic of the mountains on film will be his claim to fame.
households.name: Anderson family
households.key: Anderson family (Hidden Springs) | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Ryan Anderson

households.members: Finn Annan, Fawn Annan, Fern Annan, Philip Annan, Flora Annan, Daisy Annan
households.caption: The Annan house can be a chaotic place as the family is large. However, there is a lot of love in the house, despite the drama.
households.key: Annan family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Finn Annan

households.members: Kara Ansari, Raja Ansari
households.caption: Kara is unhappy and yearns for money, power, prestige, too bad she is married to a farmer! Being a farmer suits Raja nicely... for now. He has secret ambitions to become the master of all evil and rule the world! Crafty, secretive, and a whiz with technology Raja keeps his ambitions secret from his wife.
households.key: Ansari family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Kara Ansari

households.members: Frank Astare, Judy Rogers
households.caption: Already a star in her own right, Judy never shined brighter than when she and Frank danced together. Frank may lack curb appeal, but is flowing with talent. Can these two stars shine even brighter or are they doomed to fizzle out?
households.key: Astare household | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Frank Astare

households.members: Ma Bagley, Sherman Bagley, Rhoda Bagley
households.caption: The Bagley family business is just a wee bit on the wild side. Rhoda is following in her mother's footsteps, but Sherman seems to want a different path to travel.
households.key: Bagley family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Ma Bagley

households.members: Stefan Bayless, Anais Willheim
households.caption: The simple pleasures of life are the basis of Anais and Stefan's relationship. Good food, good friends, and wild parties are the staples of this loving couple's life.
households.key: Bayless-Willheim household | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Stefan Bayless

households.members: Suzuki Hinata, Ricardo Gregario, Len Tsang
households.caption: Ricardo, Len, and Suzuki have lived together since the day they graduated high school. But when his roommates grew out of their youthful awkwardness into attractive young adults, Ricardo can't help but feel left behind. Can his friends help give him the confidence to go after the girl of his dreams?
households.name: Beach Bums household
households.key: Beach Bums household | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Suzuki Hinata

households.members: Benjamin Benton, Dahlia Benton, Carly Benton, Jax Benton
households.caption: Benjamin is a star athlete, and his wife, Dahlia, takes great pride in her job in law enforcement. They push their children to follow in their footsteps - discipline, athletics, routine. Though an excellent athlete Carly has a secret passion for music, and Jax excels at everything except sports...can their parents possibly accept them for who they are?
households.key: Benton family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Benjamin Benton

households.members: Roy Phillips, Palmer Hayes
households.caption: Roy and Palmer knew each other as children, but grew apart as the years went by and they followed different paths in life. Reunited when they both happened to retire in the same desert town these two were fast to rekindle their friendship. Roy and Palmer... best friends forever!
households.name: Best Friends household
households.key: Best Friends household (Lucky Palms) | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Roy Phillips

households.members: Theodora Jayne, Ursula Lemuel
households.caption: Ursula brought her best friend, Theodora, to the island in hopes that she'd finally unwind! Her friend has everything going for her, beauty, smarts and an amazing body, but she constantly hides away. Ursula wants to bring the fun out of Theodora but doesn't intend to stay indoors and wait while there is fun to be had... there are men on this island. Plenty of men!
households.name: Best Friends household
households.key: Best Friends household (Sunlit Tides) | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Theodora Jayne

households.members: Franco Bianchi, Kaela Bianchi, Beppe Bianchi, Unborn baby Bianchi
households.caption: Franco Bianchi had a dream of being a sports star, but when his whirlwind romance brought a new wife and a son, he realized that it may be time to leave his dreams to support his family. He thinks a life of crime can bring the quick money he needs, but can he keep his family safe?
households.key: Bianchi family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Franco Bianchi

households.members: Eugene Carnegie, Ethel Carnegie, Edmund Carnegie, Elosie Carnegie
households.caption: When Eugene takes a step back and looks at his life this is not how he imagined it... A much needed respite in paradise is being ruined by his domineering wife who can't stop bossing him around long enough to enjoy the sunshine. His son is cowering further into the shadows and his daughter just can't be tamed. Can Eugene find peace on this island vacation, or will chaos rule supreme?
households.key: Carnegie family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Eugene Carnegie

households.members: Buzz Rhodes, Hope Carpenter
households.caption: Hope and Buzz have lived happily together for what seems like forever. They've worked hard to make an honest living and instill good morals in their daughter, if only she would come and visit every once in a while.
households.name: Carpenter-Rhodes family
households.key: Carpenter-Rhodes family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Buzz Rhodes

households.members: Meadow Carpenter-Rhodes
households.caption: Following in her mother's footsteps, Meadow has taken the caring of plants to a whole new level. Will she ever find room in her heart to let the seeds of love take root?
households.name: Carpenter-Rhodes family
households.key: Carpenter-Rhodes family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Meadow Carpenter-Rhodes

households.members: Bruce Chesterfield, Scott Chesterfield, Dennis Chesterfield
households.caption: Bruce has moved his sons from the city, and into the heart of nature, hoping to instill in them his own love of the outdoors.
households.key: Chesterfield family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Bruce Chesterfield

households.members: Simon Cho, Alisha Cho, Davy Cho, Minzi Cho
households.caption: Simon Cho's feature films have been so successful he's decided to reward himself with an early retirement, bringing his family along.
households.name: Cho Family
households.key: Cho family (Hidden Springs) | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Simon Cho

households.members: Endora Kravitz, Morgan Claremont, Sammi Claremont, Tabbi Claremont
households.caption: When Morgan took a new job in a new town he had no idea that his mother-in-law would be tagging along! What was supposed to be a "short visit" when their first child was born has turned into an extended stay. Will true love triumph over a meddlesome mother-in-law?
households.key: Claremont family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Endora Kravitz

households.members: Evan Clark, Jessie Clark, Wanda Clark Unborn baby Clark
households.caption: The eco-friendly atmosphere is what brought the Clarks to town. They love the Earth and they love their happy drama-free lives.
households.key: Clark family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Evan Clark

households.members: Jake Coastal, Josephine Coastal
households.caption: The Coastals adore Barnacle Bay, and their love of the town's history and the island's eco-system is evident in their home.
households.key: Coastal family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Jake Coastal

households.members: Christoff Colby, Genevieve Colby
households.caption: Christoff and Genevieve may be new to their fortune but they are determined to show the blue bloods a thing or two about class and sophistication.
households.key: Colby family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Christoff Colby

households.members: Dante Costa, Giovanna Costa, Cipriana Costa, Victoria Costa, Unborn baby Costa
households.caption: Costa is the name to fear in town. If you see a Costa, make room. If you cross a Costa, you'll pay. Dante Costa is the king of crime and he's heavily devoted to his family and his people. Your best chance is to get on his good side...and fast.
households.key: Costa family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Dante Costa

households.members: Riley Cromos, Zoe Cromos
households.caption: Riley Cromos has been living the hard life raising his daughter alone. He loves her more than anything, but as a struggling baker it's getting harder and harder to make ends meet and find ways to relate to a soon-to-be teenage girl. Can they handle the growing pains or will this weakened family be over-powered?
households.name: Cromos family
households.key: Cromos family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Riley Cromos

households.members: Odin Crosby, Heather Crosby
households.caption: It's never been clear why the Crosbys married because they are so different in so many ways. Will Riverview be a place in which they can find a way to be happy? Or will they go their separate ways?
households.key: Crosby family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Odin Crosby

households.members: Patricia Cross, Alexander Cross
households.caption: Power, wealth, and influence are the cornerstones of Patricia and Alexander's union. Too bad they don't also value romance and companionship. Patricia's main concern is saving face in order to further her political aspirations, while Alexander spends his days at the lab. Can the sparks of their former passion be rekindled, or will they continue to lead separate lives under the same roof?
households.key: Cross family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Patricia Cross

households.members: Lewis-Charlie Darwin, Preethi Darwin
households.caption: The Darwins are a scientifically inclined couple who are passionate about fish and fishing. Lewis and Preethi have a garden and a small pond they love spending time on.
households.name: Darwin Family
households.key: Darwin family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Lewis-Charlie Darwin

households.members: Norma Davidson, Gil McGinnis
households.caption: Gil and Norma are two Sims who met under strange circumstances. Norma obsessively awaits for the days of her big silver screen comeback and Gil, while down on his luck, was taken in by Norma. Can Gil repair Norma's fragile state of mind and help Norma make a comeback?
households.key: Davidson household | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Norma Davidson

households.members: Bonnie Davis, Clyde Reeves
households.caption: When Bonnie and Clyde met, it was love at first sight. Clyde is a natural daredevil who's shown Bonnie a new side of life. Bonnie is an aspiring writer and loves to write about their exploits. Will Clyde eventually lead Bonnie down the wrong path?
households.name: Davis household
households.key: Davis household (Roaring Heights) | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Bonnie Davis

households.members: Mark Davis-Welles, Rita Davis-Welles
households.caption: On the outside, Rita and Mark appear to be a happily married couple but they've both fallen in love with other people. Will they risk scandal or work to stay together?
households.key: Davis-Welles family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Mark Davis-Welles

households.members: Miriam Day, Angelica Diamond, Pedro Herrerra, Ciro Perry
households.caption: The Hostility-Free Hostel is the place weary and cash strapped young travelers stay when they come to Aurora Skies. Miriam, Ciro, Pedro and Angelica all came to find adventure, but in their time here will they also find reasons to stay?
households.key: Day household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Miriam Day

households.members: George Dean
households.caption: After his mother's tragic death, George Dean devoted his life to helping others. He lives in an abandoned firehouse to remind him of his dream of being the guy who can save the day.
households.key: Dean family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | George Dean

households.members: Blake Grayson, Jenny Lho
households.caption: Jenny and Blake have done everything together since they were small children... whether they've enjoyed it or not. Now these two frenemies are embarking off into the world independently… with some help from their parents funds of course.
households.key: Debutante household | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Blake Grayson

households.members: Dorren Delaney, Emma Delaney
households.caption: Emma loves her father and their eco-conscious lifestyle, but she yearns for a bit more freedom. What's the harm in eating out of paper disposable paper products every once in awhile or driving a modern automobile? She wants to teach her dad that you can save the earth, and live in it too.
households.name: Delaney family
households.key: Delaney family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Dorren Delaney

households.members: Dario DeLuca, Veronica DeLuca, Teresa DeLuca
households.caption: The DeLuca family has a lot of love. Dario is a sweet, sloppy scientist married to the love of his wife Veronica, the smart, sharp squad leader, with their daughter a stylish, self-confident student named Teresa. What's not to love?
households.name: DeLuca family
households.key: DeLuca family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Dario DeLuca

households.members: Taj Diwan, Zahra Diwan, Sahan Diwan
households.caption: Special Agent Taj Diwan is deep undercover in his investigation of the drained lake bed and the Sims who live there! To aid his deception he's brought his family with him. Aided by his dedicated and supportive wife, Zahra, he has infiltrated the small neighborhood and is investigating criminal activities in the area.
households.key: Diwan family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Taj Diwan

households.members: John Doe, Jane Doe, Joseph Doe, Jennifer Doe, James Doe, Unborn baby Doe
households.caption: Jane is the perfect housewife, from her neat hairstyle to her fashionable yet conservative dress. She's neat, nurturing, loves her kids, and can make a mean pot roast! Meanwhile, John is rising in the ranks at his corporate job. He feels successful in life and supported by his family. He works hard but comes home in enough time to teach his kids a lesson or two about life and talk to his wife about her day. Nothing mysterious seems to be happening here, but didn't their house used to have a basement?
households.key: Doe family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | John Doe

households.members: Wynn Byrne, Finn Dolan, Sarah Dolan
households.caption: Finn never imagined that he'd marry the girl that he rescued from a vicious wolf attack all of those years ago, but here he is living with an elderly grandmother and a beautiful wife with the affinity for red hoods. Now that they're expecting their first child he wonders if it's time to increase his vigilant watch for danger or begin to let down his guard?
households.name: Dolan household
households.key: Dolan household | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Wynn Byrne

households.members: Martin Eames, Maeve Eames, Liam Eames, Unborn baby Eames
households.caption: Maeve lived her life on a ship. Her father was the captain of a ship and her youth was spent pillaging towns with her best friend, Martin. Now married and in their adulthood, Maeve and Martin are having a hard time getting used to the parent life with their young son Liam. With another little one on the way, the question is will they settle or will they sail?
households.name: Eames family
households.key: Eames family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Martin Eames

households.members: Jackie Elliot, Felicia Lin
households.caption: Jackie Elliot and Felicia Lin are your run of the mill town residents. Stylish and sweet, these women could never be Jackie and Felicia, the jewelry and art thieves on the run from the law. Could they?
households.key: Elliot household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Jackie Elliot

households.members: Todd Landgraab, Karl Simon, Seema Sielen
households.caption: Seema has the charm, Karl has the smarts, and Todd has the money. They're pressured by friends, family, and society to make something of themselves and they have a plan! Entrepreneurship is a real thing...right?
households.key: Entrepreneurs household | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Todd Landgraab

households.members: Haffeef Safari, Jaqualine Beels, Chris Masters
households.key: EP9 PWT Heroes | The Sims 3 Store |  | Haffeef Safari

households.members: Isadora Fitzpatrick, Niles Fitzpatrick
households.caption: Niles and Isadora love their life together. Without children neither their bodies or wallets have been ravaged by the sands of time. Now in their old age they enjoy the peaceful elegance of island life. Lobster Thermidor anyone?
households.key: Fitzpatrick family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Isadora Fitzpatrick

households.members: Edmund Flynn, Maggie Flynn, Mitchell Flynn, Cora Flynn
households.caption: When Jackson Bishop received a letter from the Flynn estate lawyer detailing the poor, rich orphans who were coming to live with their long lost Uncle they've never met, he decided this was his chance to improve his standing and become guardians of the children for their fortune. Good old Edmund Flynn passed in a tragic accident and the kids *did* need a guardian after all. He's just being charitable!...right.
households.name: Flynn family
households.key: Flynn family (Midnight Hollow) | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Edmund Flynn

households.members: Nicholas Riverhawk, Cassidy Earthsong, Jessica Willow
households.caption: Drawn to the raw nature and mysteries of the mountain, Nicholas, Cassidy, and Jessica have decided to live a life of sustainable oneness with the Earth for as long as they can stand it.
households.key: Free Spirit household | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Nicholas Riverhawk

households.members: Barry Gilbert, Hanson Gilbert, Joshua Gilbert
households.caption: After the death of his beloved wife, Barry felt a change of scene was in order and bought property over a popular online auction site. Unfortunately he paid double what the "cozy lake front abode" was worth and is stuck with his poor investment. The bills are high and the lake is dry... will the family stick together through these tough times?
households.key: Gilbert family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Barry Gilbert

households.members: Georgia Giordano, Paloma Giordano, Alessandra Giordano
households.caption: The Giordano Sisters couldn't be any different. Though all pretty and smart, their personalities clash. Georgia is rude, Paloma is shy, and Alessandra is just trying to find her place in the world. Without their parents to guide them, can the Giordano Sisters stay together?
households.name: Giordano family
households.key: Giordano family (Monte Vista) | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Georgia Giordano

households.members: Eleanor Goldbeard, Tobias Goldbeard, Anne Goldbeard, Coral Goldbeard, Kidd Goldbeard
households.caption: Not only are The Goldbeards the wealthiest family for nautical miles, they are also the most socially and politically connected. Most people overlook how they built their wealth.
households.key: Goldbeard family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Eleanor Goldbeard

households.members: Gennie Gomez, Beulah Patterson, Evangeline Finch
households.caption: Three gifted women, best friends through thick and thin, are living together during their golden years, Gennie is a talented artist, Beulah is an expert angler, and Evangeline enjoys gardening and hacking. These brilliant women are determined to make the best of the rest of their lives!
households.key: Golden Gals household | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Gennie Gomez

households.members: Bennie Dean, Henry McGlum, Melvin Taft
households.caption: When Bennie Dean's wife died he couldn't adjust to living alone so he asked his good friends Henry and Melvin to move in and share expenses. But are they too old and set in their ways to get along?
households.key: Grandpas household | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Bennie Dean

households.members: Gavin Grantham, Alice Grantham, Sophie Grantham, Katherine Grantham, Unborn baby Grantham
households.caption: Gavin had it all planned out for a son. Football in the yard, teaching him to drive, telling him how to treat a girl at prom, but when his wife Alice had a baby girl and followed by ANOTHER girl he's concerned that a baby boy is a long way off... He's brought his family to the island to get some rest and relaxation before he asks his wife to try just one more time for the son of his dreams. Little do they know there is a surprise in store for them all!
households.key: Grantham family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Gavin Grantham

households.members: Walter Grisby, Yvette Grisby, Laurel Grisby
households.caption: Walter and Yvette know that beauty is in the eye of the beholder. They love each other for who they truly are. Will their daughter find someone who can see her inner beauty as well?
households.key: Grisby family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Walter Grisby

households.members: Kimo Hale, Talei Hale, Kiwi Hale
households.caption: Kimo likes order in his home, in his life, and, most importantly, in his work. Talei fears her cold husband and spends her time sheltering their son, ensuring he gets all of the love he needs. When the mysterious Silas Allender starts showing her warm romantic attentions, she can't help but wonder what the future might be like with someone new...
households.key: Hale family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Kimo Hale

households.members: Andrea Hallur, Lara Hallur
households.caption: Moving back in with her mother after her divorce was hard on Lara and even harder was leaving the light of her life, her daughter Kristin. She's happy that her unhappy marriage is over and her free spirit is free, but she wonders if she can really find joy in the second half of her life?
households.key: Hallur family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Andrea Hallur

households.members: Olivier Harbucks, Shirley Templeton
households.caption: Although Olivier had more money and possessions than ever, he was missing one thing – a family. Fate took a strange turn when one day an orphan named Shirley appeared on his doorstep. Will Olivier finally help Shirley realize her dreams of stardom?
households.key: Harbucks household | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Olivier Harbucks

households.members: Lief Helgason, Karen Helgason, Karl Helgason, Kristin Helgason
households.caption: Lief Helgason loves his 3 children more than he can say. So much so that he fought for custody in all three of his nasty divorces. People might think him strange for having each of his children from different wives, but this old-fashioned man falls in love hard and quick. Can this single dad take care of his children alone or is wife number 4 on the horizon?
households.connect: Apple family, Hallur family, Vinter family
households.key: Helgason family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Lief Helgason

households.members: Hugh Hoffman, Hazel Hoffman, Helen Hoffman, Hector Hoffman
households.caption: Hazel loves her family more than she can say, but being a super wife to a successful husband and raising two wonderful children has left her tired and stressed. When Hugh offers a stay on an island paradise she jumps at the chance to relax and maybe leave her husband with the kids for the day... with family bonding at an all time high is there any reason for the Hoffmans to ever leave the island?
households.name: Hoffman family
households.key: Hoffman family (Sunlit Tides) | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Hugh Hoffman

households.members: Robin Hooley, Marian Hooley
households.caption: Robin loves the common man and will do anything he can to help, illegal or not. He and his wife Marian have little money and few possessions because he keeps giving them away! He has good intentions, but Marian hopes to teach him that stealing isn't the way to go.
households.name: Hooley family
households.key: Hooley family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Robin Hooley

households.members: Clark Houveir, Louise Houveir
households.caption: Clark is a man who gets what he wants, including Louise who puts on a fake smile, much to her dismay. Clark is too busy cooking up the next scheme and Louise desperately wants attention. Can this odd couple stay together or was their marriage doomed to fail from the start?
households.key: Houveir family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Clark Houveir

households.members: Ariel Hudson, Kinslee Hudson
households.caption: Madly in love and daring enough to break convention, this young couple is pregnant with their first child and shunning the civil trappings of wedlock, though they have decided to share Kinslee's last name. Can these wily hipsters maintain their unique perspective on life amid a more conservative desert crowd?
households.key: Hudson Hipsters household | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Ariel Hudson

households.members: Iris Ingberg, Jakob Ingberg, Jonas Ingberg, Unborn baby Ingberg
households.caption: What happens when a brilliant scientist and a top-tier surgeon marry and have a very average child? Have another child and try again! Can Jakob and Iris show little Jonas enough love while they're busy hoping for better?
households.key: Ingberg family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Iris Ingberg

households.members: Shorty-John Inkbeard, Victoria Inkbeard, Morgan Inkbeard, Aeisha Inkbeard, Pearl Inkbeard, Bart Inkbeard
households.caption: The Inkbeard family name seems to be a reference to an ancestral sea victory over a Giant Squid. There are rumours of fabulous wealth plundered and then lost which makes this family suspicious of everyone.
households.key: Inkbeard family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Shorty-John Inkbeard

households.members: Richard Irwin, Emi Irwin, Cricket Irwin
households.caption: Unemployed, unreliable, and unfaithful Richard is hardly a good role model. And though beautiful Emi Irwin is deeply troubled and working on the wrong side of the law... is there any hope for their daughter to have a normal childhood?
households.key: Irwin family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Richard Irwin

households.members: Rayna Kaminski, Yuri Ivanov, Nadine Ivanov, Tatiana Ivanov, Dimitri Ivanov
households.caption: Grandma Kaminski and her family have been wandering around for years. When her daughter married Yuri Ivanov and had two children, she suggested they try to find a place to settle down. Will Riverview keep their interest for long?
households.key: Ivanov family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Rayna Kaminski

households.members: Phillip James, Mia James, Unborn baby James
households.caption: Newlyweds Mia and Phillip have been busy furnishing their home and enjoying their new life together. Warmth and love abounds, but there is one thing missing from their idyllic family life - a baby.
households.key: James family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Phillip James

households.members: Jayden James, David Haynes
households.caption: Jayden and David are the hottest men to walk the catwalk in years. Every fashion designer wants to book them and every girl wants to be with them. All they want is to live a normal life. In town for work, they still do their best to blend in with the crowd in the hopes that the only photos taken of them will be the ones they get paid for.
households.name: James household
households.key: James household | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Jayden James

households.members: Martin January, Lily January
households.caption: Martin moved to the edge of town so that his scientist wife could pursue her passions. But Lily works too much and Martin misses the social scene. Though she loves her husband dearly Lily is easily distracted by her work and tends to neglect him. Can their relationship be salvaged, or will Martin leave Lily and return to his old life?
households.key: January family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Martin January

households.members: Aiden Jones, Hannah Jones
households.caption: When the Jones Family inherited the Remington Estate from Hannah's cousins, they imagined a beautiful vista and the quaint little town. They didn't imagine that they would be seeing specters! Can they find a way to restore the restless ghosts?
households.name: Jones family
households.key: Jones family (Riverview) | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Aiden Jones

households.members: Beverly Jones, Helen Jones, Edward Jones
households.caption: Beverly is a fashion queen who has everything "en mode" except her children, thanks to the sudden death of her husband. Her son Edward turns a blind eye towards fashion and her daughter Helen wants nothing more than some attention from Beverly. Will Beverly find a new husband to save her family?
households.name: Jones family
households.key: Jones family (Roaring Heights) | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Beverly Jones

households.members: Norman Joy, Elaine Joy
households.caption: Norman Joy and his wife wanted their daughter to grow up on home grown food and family values. When his wife died, Norman did his best to provide for Elaine. Will she follow her parent's dreams or break away and make a life of her own?
households.key: Joy family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Norman Joy

households.members: Sean Kelly, Ava Kelly
households.caption: Ava Kelly is young, fierce, and wanting to make a name for herself in town. That name is Kelly; Ava Kelly. Sean loves his driven wife and he'll do anything to help her get ahead. Even if that means making a name for himself just to stay at her side.
households.name: Kelly family
households.key: Kelly family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Sean Kelly

households.members: Kim Kent, Piper Hipp, Liam O'Dourke
households.key: Kent household | The Sims 3 Store |  | Kim Kent

households.members: Brayden King, Kadia King, Abrianna King, Abrielle King
households.caption: The Kings are pillars of respectability and popularity. Their twin daughters excel scholastically and are both gifted with creative talents. As these two cultivated teens grow into adulthood where will their life paths take them? And what will their parents do once their little birds have flown?
households.name: King family
households.key: King family (Lucky Palms) | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Brayden King

households.members: Thomas LaFontaine, Elizabeth LaFontaine
households.caption: Elizabeth wants a simple life, without distractions like affection for others, yet her father Thomas firmly disagrees. Worried that she’ll be Simoleonless and alone, Thomas is committed to finding her a husband. Will true love ever find Elizabeth or will a forced marriage create a rift between Elizabeth and Thomas?
households.key: LaFontaine family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Thomas LaFontaine

households.members: Gil Lai, Laurel Lai, Jonah Lai, Unborn baby Lai
households.caption: The Lai family has been fishing for as far back as anyone can imagine, and some of their ancestors even have portraits up in City Hall. Of course why they are brandishing cutlasses no historian has quite figured out.
households.key: Lai family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Gil Lai

households.members: Lola Lancaster, Unborn baby Lancaster
households.caption: Dazzling former showgirl Lola has been entertaining a steady string of gentlemen since the untimely, and according to the police "accidental", death of her husband. But one affair may have gone too far...pregnant and in love with a married man, what's a girl to do?!
households.key: Lancaster family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Lola Lancaster

households.members: Arthur Langerak, Gloria Goode
households.caption: It was love at first sight for Gloria and Arthur! They bonded over their passion for books and music and their engagement was announced six short weeks after they met. Arthur works hard to provide a good life for his future wife, but the daily drudgery of a salary man may not be for him…
households.key: Langerak-Goode household | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Arthur Langerak

households.members: Mai Lau, Annie Lau, Lucy Lau
households.caption: The Lau triplets were the foremost scientists in the field of optimizing the human body to better the earth. After an experiment went awry the women were left with super fit physiques and the need for a new purpose in life. Each sister took on a new career that would employ their newfound physical prowess.
households.key: Lau family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Mai Lau

households.members: Roxie Lin, Shirley Lin
households.caption: Roxie Lin is a wild child and her sister, Shirley, is just the opposite. The only thing they have in common is stubbornness. When they moved into their parents old house, they couldn't decide on the décor so they divided it up and defied traditional interior design.
households.key: Lin family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Roxie Lin

households.members: Angel Lobos, Marisol Lobos, Carlotta Lobos, Anita Lobos
households.caption: The Lobos family needed a fresh start. Will Riverview be the place they can create the solid family life that they want for their twins?
households.key: Lobos family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Angel Lobos

households.members: Pax Louie, Louisa Louie, Nadia Louie
households.caption: The once prestigious Louie family was forced to move to the outskirts of town after Pax had a falling out with Patricia Cross. Used to the finer things in life the bohemian lifestyle is very foreign to them…will they be able to adapt and thrive, or will Pax make up with Patricia and beg for his old job back?
households.key: Louie family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Pax Louie

households.members: Eli Vokoban, Lina Lancaster, Unborn baby Lancaster
households.caption: Eli is frugal which has made him rich. Being rich has attracted the lovely Lina Lancaster to his side. Eli has showered the young Lina with gifts and provided her with own posh suite in his mansion, but Eli doesn't know that Lina is pregnant, a secret which may tear these two apart.
households.key: Lovers? household | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Eli Vokoban

households.members: Doris Lucas, Finn Lucas, Theresa Lucas
households.caption: Money is tight and Doris, a single mom with a teenage son and deviant daughter, struggles to keep her family together. Can her aspirations of becoming a famous painter fund her family and help them find a better life?
households.key: Lucas family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Doris Lucas

households.members: Teagan MacAnna, Shannon MacAnna
households.caption: Teagan is the exact opposite of her sweet, innocent sister, Shannon. Dark and devious to the bone, she does whatever she wants with reckless abandon and no consideration for others. Who cares if there is no "I" in Team? There is an "I" in Mine and that's all that matters.
households.name: MacAnna family
households.key: MacAnna family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Teagan MacAnna

households.members: Buzz Malifa, Petunia Malifa, Marcus Malifa
households.caption: Filled with all of Buzz's knick knacks and clutter, this household is a clash of tastes and styles. The personalities in this house also tend to collide, but this family has learned to make it work.
households.key: Malifa family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Buzz Malifa

households.members: Camillo Mancini, Carlo Mancini
households.caption: Carlo Mancini is used to calling the shots and from an early age he was prepped to take over the family business. But when his father suddenly passed away he was left with more responsibility than he could handle, including the happiness of his younger brother. Can Carlo keep it all together?
households.key: Mancini family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Camillo Mancini

households.members: Sneako Marks, Sharpo Marks, Grumpo Marks, Glummo Marks, Dyno Marks
households.caption: This set of brothers are distinct in their own way and when brought together their comedy troupe is a barrel full of laughs! Never knowing when the act is supposed to end, these brothers can't be taken seriously. Will the Marks brothers ever grow up and act their age?
households.key: Marks family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Sneako Marks

households.members: Luke McDermott, Ginny McDermott, Maximus McDermott, Travis McDermott
households.caption: The McDermotts have a way with plants. They've been growing their own food for generations, but they do try to keep up with the times. Their two young sons spend hours at the river catching fish. Will they carry on the family traditions?
households.key: McDermott family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Luke McDermott

households.members: Willy McKellar
households.caption: Willy the ex-lightkeeper has a house in the most remote part of Barnacle Bay. He is rarely seen in town.
households.key: McKellar family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Willy McKellar

households.members: Ralph Meyers, Irene Meyers
households.caption: Love has a way of making one blind, and for Ralph this is no exception. His wife Irene is as unfaithful as they get after having many affairs due to an unhappy marriage and resentment for Ralph. Will Ralph ever open his eyes and see his wife for who she really is?
households.key: Meyers family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Ralph Meyers

households.members: Fintan Mithrilen, Aine Mithrilen, Riordan Mithrilen, Unborn baby Mithrilen
households.caption: Fintan still holds bitterness in his heart over the Mithrilen family being unseated as leaders in town. He still can't believe how quickly everyone took to the foreign O'Connell family and he believes that they should have stayed on guard rather than letting little dragons into their lives. He will protect his town no matter what, but will his anger and obsession hurt his family in the long run?
households.key: Mithrilen family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Fintan Mithrilen

households.members: David Morgan, Donna Morgan, Joseph Morgan, Carolyn Morgan, Evelyn Morgan
households.caption: It would appear that David and Donna’s marriage is perfect, but in reality it’s filled with many cracks. Donna can’t bring herself to admit to seeing David and Samantha Cassat’s flirty exchanges so instead she occupies herself with her loving children. Can Donna and David keep their family together?
households.key: Morgan family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | David Morgan

households.members: Carlos Mosqueda, Paige Mosqueda, Erik Mosqueda
households.caption: Family, friendship, and food are the focus of the Mosquedas. What they lack in material goods they make up in happiness. Carlos loves to cook and throw dinner parties for their friends and neighbors.
households.key: Mosqueda family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Carlos Mosqueda

households.members: Seamus O'Connell, Shauna O'Connell, Morida O'Connell, Aiden O'Connell, Brien O'Connell
households.caption: The O'Connell family has been leading the town since their great-great grandfather Captain O'Connell landed here and helped the town tame the dragons. They love caring for the town, but they are also starting to wonder if democracy isn't more the way.
households.name: O'Connell family
households.key: O'Connell family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Seamus O'Connell

households.members: Conor O'Reilly, Chloe O'Reilly, Morrigan O'Reilly, Fiona O'Reilly, Unborn baby O'Reilly
households.caption: Women! Women! Women! They're all that Conor sees. He opens his eyes to his youngest daughter vying for his attention and closes his eyes to his harried wife hoping for some rest, with a sprinkle of his teenage daughter rolling her eyes at him in between. What a life! He's overwhelmed, but he wouldn't change a minute of it.
households.name: O'Reilly family
households.key: O'Reilly family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Conor O'Reilly

households.members: Breandan O'Shea, Kearney O'Shea
households.caption: Kearney and Breandan are always jousting to be the best. When Breandan got muscles, Kearney got bigger muscles. When Kearney got a girlfriend, Breandan got a prettier girlfriend! When Breandan joined law enforcement, Kearney joined the Military! Kearney thinks he's the best brother, but then again so does Brendan! When will they learn that they're really quite the same?
households.name: O'Shea family
households.key: O'Shea family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Breandan O'Shea

households.members: Estella Olivia, Sophia Rios, Unborn baby Olivia
households.caption: Estella and Sophia came to town for a wild weekend that turned into an endless spree! Settling down is for losers and they're going to party well into their elders years. What will an unexpected baby do to these plans?
households.key: Olivia household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Estella Olivia

households.members: Oskar Olsen, Emil Olsson
households.caption: When Oskar lost his wife, Anna, he thought his life wouldn't go on. But it did! He moved in with his life long best friend Emil and they spent many happy years together in the sunset of their lives. When Oskar lost Emil, he thought his life wouldn't go on. And it didn't! But the bonds of friendship were too strong for the afterlife, so Emil and Oskar still spend their ghostly existence together in Aurora Skies.
households.key: Olsson household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Oskar Olsen

households.members: Josefin Oss, Arvid Oss, Edvin Oss
households.caption: Josefin has been through all of the worst that the world has to offer, including the early loss of her husband. She works with all she has to protect her two sons from any more pain. She tries to teach her sons to stay on the right path, but will her close care cause them to rebel?
households.key: Oss family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Josefin Oss

households.members: Juan Jr. Inkbeard, Ahmed Barbarossa, Lee-Roy Johnkins
households.caption: Three rowdy singles enjoy being on their own for the first time. They love hosting parties and being best friends, even when the occasional drama ensues.
households.key: Parrrrrrrty household | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Juan Jr. Inkbeard

households.members: Martin Pepper, Penelope Pepper, Laurita Pepper
households.caption: Martin hoped that the beautiful scenery and change of pace would help mend his family after the death of his father. Sadly, as his mother continues to retreat into depression and his sister continues to retreat into selfish disregard, he knows it's up to him to set his family right. But is the burden too much for one so young?
households.key: Pepper family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Martin Pepper

households.members: Noel Perry, Emma Perry
households.caption: Noel and Emma knew living together would be fun! Sisters who just reached adulthood, in a beautiful town, living the good life! Both girls loves to party and have fun, but Emma wants to be responsible too. Can she convince her sister that it's time to grow up?
households.name: Perry family
households.key: Perry family (Monte Vista) | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Noel Perry

households.members: Lonnie Pertridge, Astrid Pertridge, Eunice Pertridge, Ella Carlisle
households.caption: Lonnie Pertridge has moved here with her two "lovely" daughters in hopes that a royal wedding might be in their future. Too bad she had to bring the help -- er, her step daughter along as well.
households.key: Pertridge family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Lonnie Pertridge

households.members: Nancy Picard, Gerald Picard, Frances Picard
households.caption: When Nancy’s husband passed away, she immediately fretted for her future and the only hope for survival lie in her children. Gerald continually rejects his mom’s attempts to send him on dates and Frances thinks her smarts will get her ahead instead of getting married. Will Nancy find another way to survive?
households.key: Picard family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Nancy Picard

households.members: Dave Piece
households.caption: Dave lamented her death and tried to find his love elsewhere, but it seems he is unlucky, and has already ended two relationships. Can he find the love again?
households.key: Piece family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Dave Piece

households.members: Cassidy Predergast, Orion Lawless, Nora Lawless, Dillon Lawless, Sophie Dwyer, Corren Dwyer, Cara Gallgher
households.caption: Cassidy was never able to have children of her own, but it didn't matter. There were always children in town without a parent. Parents lost to Dragon fires, house fires, fire fires…. Times are tough and orphans need love too.
households.name: Prendergast family
households.key: Prendergast household | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Cassidy Predergast

households.members: Monty Prince, Clarice Prince, Cornell Evans, Cecelia Evans
households.caption: Cecilia and Cornell have had enough. Instead of living the life of normal children their mother has forced them into a regimented existence that has stifled their creativity and freedom. Sure they know more skills in their early youth than most Sims would know in a lifetime, but at what cost? They've run away to live with their grandparents hoping to find out who they are and who they want to be before adulthood sets in.
households.key: Prince family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Monty Prince

households.members: Richie Radan, Rahul Patel
households.caption: These two bachelors are vacationing in Barnacle Bay, taking a break from the stress of daily life. Is there a chance this could be a permanent stay?
households.key: Radan household | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Richie Radan

households.members: Roger Rao, Mia Rao, Unborn baby Rao
households.caption: The Rao's are in the beginning stages of starting a family, and this modest house is the perfect size for mom, dad, and baby. Hopefully it isn't twins!
households.key: Rao family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Roger Rao

households.members: Luigi Ricardo, Paola Romano, Orlando Romano
households.caption: Paola was living a good life when her husband suddenly passed away. Very quickly her life turned from comfortable to barely making ends meet. Luckily her brother offered to move in to help with bills and providing a male role model to her young son Orlando. Orlando hasn't smiled in months and she can't help but wonder if her family can ever recover.
households.name: Romano family
households.key: Romano family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Luigi Ricardo

households.members: Phoenix Ross, Addison Ross, Marissa Ross
households.caption: Marissa has been very successful in her pursuit of a top tier business career, but Phoenix has failed to find success in the military. As Marissa spends more and more time at work Phoenix finds himself raising their daughter alone. Will these former lovebirds find their way back to one another, or does a separation loom in the future?
households.key: Ross family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Phoenix Ross

households.members: Costanzo Rossi, Adalina Rossi, Unborn baby Rossi
households.caption: As the mayor of the town, Costanzo Rossi believes he has it all: love from his beautiful wife, respect and friendship from the townspeople, and all of the money he could need. When he finds out that his lovely wife pregnant he can't help but wonder, can any one man really be this lucky?
households.key: Rossi family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Costanzo Rossi

households.members: Carly Ruiz, Emmit Preston, Jake Preston
households.caption: This Nanny took a trip with the family she works for only to get stuck with the two kids while the parents have disappeared!
households.key: Ruiz household | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Carly Ruiz

households.members: Susie Sackholme, Mason Sackholme
households.caption: Lots of things always seem to happen around Susie & Mason. Though well-intentioned, they usually fall prey to some scheme or attack and danger seems to follow them wherever they go. That doesn't keep the men and women in town from being hopelessly attracted to them, however. Some think it's because there may have been fairy in their blood line.
households.name: Sackholme family
households.key: Sackholme family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon Valley | Susie Sackholme

households.members: Jay Salas, Tatiana Salas, Sandra Salas, Frieda Salas, Unborn baby Salas
households.caption: Tatiana couldn't believe her luck at the ghost mixer when the attractive Jay walked her way and asked her name. Now years later she has the home she always dreamed of and the family she thought she'd missed out on. Science doesn't explain how it works, but she thinks their family is powered by Love.
households.key: Salas family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Jay Salas

households.members: Yumi Sekemoto, Leighton Sekemoto, Sam Sekemoto
households.caption: Yumi Sekemoto has recently moved in with her son, Leighton, to help him raise his toddler, Sam.
households.key: Sekemoto family | The Sims 3 | Sunset Valley | Yumi Sekemoto

households.members: Len Sekemoto, Gretel Sekemoto, Kristofer Sekemoto
households.caption: The Sekemotos are a science minded bunch! Gretel is a top tier geologist and Len an all-star astronomer. Together they delve deeper into their love of science while raising their gifted son.
households.name: Sekemoto family
households.key: Sekemoto family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Len Sekemoto

households.members: Chan Seng, Vanna Seng, Kannitha Seng, Khang Seng
households.caption: Kannitha feels like the odd girl out. She excels at school, has plenty of friends, and is heading towards a bright future, but to her fitness buff family she might as well be invisible. Her parents and brother are far more exciting than chess awards. Can Kannitha stand out in a family of winners?
households.key: Seng family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Chan Seng

households.members: Kurt Shallow, Tom Shallow, June Shallow, Dallas Shallow, MaryKay Shallow
households.caption: It isn't love that keeps the Shallow family living under one roof. They don't even like each other. So what is it that holds this family together?
households.key: Shallow family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Kurt Shallow

households.members: Pierce Shawkti, Sidney Shawkti
households.caption: Pierce Shawkti was a master on the slopes earlier in his life, but now he's focused on building a new life for himself and his daughter Sidney.
households.key: Shawkti family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Pierce Shawkti

households.members: Dylan Shear, Audrey Shear, Charlie Shear
households.caption: Dylan's preference for wearing suits might be the scandal of the century, but she doesn't mind. Audrey desperately wants a child, and now science has made it possible. What impact will a child have on their lives?
households.key: Shear family | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Dylan Shear

households.members: Granny Shue, Dany Shue, Carlotta Shue, Gary Shue, Star Shue
households.caption: Granny Shue has always had a soft spot for children but for some reason she never settled down to have any of her own. Deciding that there were plenty of children in the world who needed a loving family she's adopted a brood of her own.
households.key: Shue family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Granny Shue

households.members: Hyun-Moon Jun, Jin Sang Kim, Young Jae Sung, Nadia Cho
households.caption: Nadia had a hard time convincing her bandmates that she should be taken seriously as the lead vocalist in their band, but one metal growl during an argument and they were sold. Don't let her size fool you, this girl can rock.
households.key: Sombre household | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Hyun-Moon Jun

households.members: Andrew Song, Jewel Song
households.caption: Jewel Song has an eye for all things sparkling… whether they belong to her or not. But this newly wed has vowed to turn over a new leaf and is willing to go through great lengths to hide the past her new husband knows so little about.
households.key: Song family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Andrew Song

households.members: Felix Soto, Mary Soto
households.caption: This elderly couple has been in Barnacle Bay for decades, and they have the souvenirs to prove it. This just might be the cutest couple on the island.
households.name: Soto family
households.key: Soto family (Barnacle Bay) | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle Bay | Felix Soto

households.members: Walker Sparks, Piper Sparks
households.caption: Widowed when his daughter was just a baby, Walker has struggled to balance his career and raise his child. His want to provide Piper with financial security has turned him into a workaholic and an absent father. Too late Walker sees the damage that has been done... can he mend his relationship with his daughter before he loses her forever?
households.key: Sparks family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Walker Sparks

households.members: Nellie Spenster, Lucille Spenster
households.caption: The Spenster sisters do not suffer the company of fools. They were raised to take care of themselves and they've done very well, thank you. But there are some interesting new neighbors in town. Will they welcome them with open arms?
households.key: Spenster family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverview | Nellie Spenster

households.members: Marcello Stefani, Su Lin Chang, Rosaria Stefani
households.caption: Su Lin Chang always gets what she wants. A husband? Done. A child? Done. A corporate reputation that makes everyone fears the name Chang? Done! She's smart and ruthless but will her lack of consideration for others catch up to her?
households.name: Stefani family
households.key: Stefani family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte Vista | Marcello Stefani

households.members: Julian Strong, Maggie Strong
households.caption: After the death of his wife, Julian has had the hardest time connecting with his daughter. From hairstyles, to wardrobe, to puberty, life has been hard on the Strong family, and teenage Maggie is showing some signs of wear. Julian is worried that his wonderful daughter won't be the woman he knows she can be, but when she starts bringing around young Edmund Carnegie he has to decide whether or not he can let his daughter be the woman she wants to be...
households.key: Strong family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Julian Strong

households.members: Damien Su, Bethany Su, Timothy Su, Irene Su
