households.caption: The Su's marriage looks perfect on the outside, but is cracking underneath. Damien is a workaholic who spends too much time away from home, and raising two young children alone has made Bethany a bundle of nervous anxiety. Can Damien be bothered to find the time to save his marriage?
households.name: Su family
households.key: Su family (Lunar Lakes) | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Damien Su

households.members: Stefan Svard, Stein Svard
households.caption: The Svard brothers have been trying to make it big in the music industry for as long as anyone could remember, but their legend doesn't extend past the bounds of town. Their talent is only hindered by a lack of funds, but they haven't given up hope! Stein continues to practice daily while Stefan works in Journalism to increase their cash flow. Will these two ever get their world tour?
households.key: Svard family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Stefan Svard

households.members: Roderick Synapse, Sarah Holden
households.caption: Dr. Synapse never meant to be an evil scientist. He loved science, he just didn't love Love. It was far too complicated. So he did what any scientist would do. He kidnapped the sweetest girl in his former town to dissect her brain and figure out just how Love works. You know, For Science!
households.key: Synapse household | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Roderick Synapse

households.members: Romon Tanner, Aya Tanner, Ethan Tanner, Yuna Tanner, Unborn baby Tanner
households.caption: Four generations of cooking excellence define the Tanner family name, but now an upstart with a fancy pedigree has come to challenge the Tanners as the best chefs in town. Will Ethan's home grown culinary skills triumph over the formal training of his nemesis?
households.key: Tanner family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Romon Tanner

households.members: Ezekiel Reid, Pansy Northrop
households.caption: Ezekiel inherited his father's home back when there was still a lake. Unfortunately for him, when the water vanished the real estate's value did too. Unable to sell and too poor to leave he found a paying roommate in military cadet Northrop. Can this unlikely twosome cohabitate in peace, or will their differing personalities lead to conflict?
households.key: The Unlikely Twosome household | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Ezekiel Reid

households.members: Janet Torrance, Marilyn Downes
households.caption: Marilyn is a socialite who snubs the lower class, yet doesn't know her roommate Janet comes from a lower class family despite being lifelong friends. A subtly rescued dress here and a well-made "catered" meal there kept the ruse going. Will Marilyn ever discover the hoax or can Janet keep it going forever?
households.key: Torrance household | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | Janet Torrance

households.members: Jesper Sandstrom, Viktor Valquist, Linn Valstrom
households.caption: Viktor Valquist and Jesper Sandstrom have been inseparable for years. Not only do they live together, town residents often see them walking in the park, out at restaurants, or touring the museum together. Now that Viktor has adopted a daughter, Linn Valstrom, their home is full of happiness and joy.
households.key: Valquist household | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Jesper Sandstrom

households.members: Renauld Vanderburg, Catarina Vanderburg, Sebastian Vanderburg
households.caption: Decesendants from a long line of Royals, H.R.H. Catarina Vanderburg is at her wits end. It's about time her children start considering the future of the Vanderburg name. Too bad the Princess has gone missing and the last thing on the Prince's mind is settling down...
households.name: Vanderburg family
households.key: Vanderburg family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Renauld Vanderburg

households.members: Sofia Vanderburg
households.caption: Sofia strongly believes that everyone should be free to pursue their true passion! Anti-establishment and anti-authority political views have always been her credo, but now she finds herself drawn to a military man… can Sofia reconcile her feelings for Michael Tomyoy while staying true to her beliefs?
households.name: Vanderburg family
households.key: Vanderburg family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar Lakes | Sofia Vanderburg

households.members: Fausto Alvarado Vasquez, Marina Rosa Vasquez
households.caption: Fausto has always been known for his good looks and his charming personality and he rode on those traits for most of his life. Now as he sees his youth fading and realizes he has no real talent or experience to speak of, he realizes he needs a new plan. He can love someone significantly older than him right? Or at least pretend to for awhile?
households.name: Vasquez family
households.key: Vasquez family (Midnight Hollow) | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Fausto Alvarado Vasquez

households.members: Tinna Vinter, Astrid Vinter, Veronika Vinter
households.caption: Astrid gives her all to not end up like her mother or sister. Bitter about life and love, they have a negative word to say about everything while Astrid likes her life happy and healthy. With her recent Miss Aurora Skies win and a new relationship with Gunnar Hannes, she has plenty to be happy about. Can Astrid shake off the negativity of the ladies in her life or is she doomed to their misery?
households.key: Vinter family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Tinna Vinter

households.members: Leo Wahine, Sera Wahine, Tenika Wahine, Luna Wahine, Twikki Wahine
households.caption: Leo & Sera are the island favorites. Married straight out of high school, they went straight to work filling their home with lots of kids, and lots of love. But Tenika is grown up and in love with a man her father refuses to accept... will she bend to her family's wishes, or risk their disapproval in the name of love?
households.connect: Hale family, Kahale family, Alto family
households.key: Wahine family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Leo Wahine

households.members: MD Fields, May West
households.caption: These two actors are rising stars on the vaudeville scene with their mesmerizing and entertaining performances. They've not only won the hearts of many Sims, but also their Simoleons too! Will Mary and MD's show continue to grow or will it become yesterday's news?
households.key: West household | The Sims 3 Store | Roaring Heights | MD Fields

households.members: Cedrick Winchester, Odessa Winchester
households.caption: Odessa and Cedrick come from a long line of blue-blooded royals but had their throne usurped when the townsfolk felt that they were a bit too crazy to be rulers. They've found a town where they feel comfortable and they're trying their hand at Politics. Royalty here, Royalty there, what does it matter when you're royalty?
households.key: Winchester family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Cedrick Winchester

households.members: Peter Winterly, Adele Winterly, Charles Winterly
households.caption: The Winterly's have both blue blood and old money. Classic aristocrats they've been lured to town not only by it's luxurious setting but also by the promises of healing their sickly son, Charles.
households.key: Winterly family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden Springs | Peter Winterly

households.members: Ari Wong, Rajita Wong, Jennika Wong
households.caption: Rajita Wong doesn't know what to do with her husband. The whimsical charm of his wacky personality wore off...onto their daughter! It was all right when they were back home, but here in a new town it's time for a change. Can she fix her daughter's style before it's too late?
households.key: Wong family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Ari Wong

households.members: Johan Wrede, Elin Wrede, Cassidy Wrede
households.caption: Fish and Fitness is the name of the game for the Wrede family. If you can learn the dedication it takes to catch your biggest fish or lift your heaviest weight, you'll have all you need to know in life, right?
households.key: Wrede family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora Skies | Johan Wrede

households.members: Viola Yates, Morgan Yates
households.caption: Morgan loves his mother. More than anyone or anything. There's nothing creepy about this. They're just best friends and hang out alone together in their large quiet home. Visitors can hear her, and passersby can see her in the window, but no one has ever actually seen her face.
households.key: Yates family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | Viola Yates

households.members: Alonso Candelaria, Rosalind Cruzita
households.caption: Rosalind couldn't believe her luck when handsome Alonso Candelaria said he was crazy about her, and she really couldn't believe it when he proposed a romantic getaway! Perhaps it was being so smitten that clouded her eyes to the fact that he's been spending an awful lot of time with the other young women they met on the beach?
households.key: Young Romance household | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit Tides | Alonso Candelaria

households.members: Oscar Arellano, Vivienne Vasquez, Clark Bellamore
households.caption: Young lovers Vivienne and Oscar relocated after Viv was offered her dream job at the local science lab. Oscar's best friend Clark tagged along, but, unable to find work, ended up crashing permanently on their couch. Can this young romance survive their unexpected house guest?
households.key: Young Trio household | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky Palms | Oscar Arellano

households.members: David Ziggfield, Alia Ziggfield
households.caption: David and Alia Ziggfield are all about reinvention, innovation, and striking visual presentation. She's a model turned surgeon and his current style is a glam rock flamboyant androgynous alter ego out to change the world.
households.key: Ziggfield family | The Sims 3 Store | Midnight Hollow | David Ziggfield

households.members: Jin Anjali, Hetal Anjali
households.key: Anjali family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Jin Anjali

households.members: Martin Bertiger, Brittany Bertiger
households.key: Bertiger family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Martin Bertiger

households.members: Michael Blanestreet, Sylvia Blanestreet, Alice Blanestreet
households.key: Blanestreet family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Michael Blanestreet

households.members: Doreen Caliente, Rick Durwood, Serena Durwood, Zoe Durwood, Zack Durwood
households.caption: On the outside, the Durwoods would make others jealous with their nice house, two adorable children, and a father with a great job. However, all is not what it seems between a mother in-law who disapproves of her daughter's husband and two kids who always get what they want. Can the Durwoods learn to live together or will the family spiral out of control?
households.key: Durwood family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Doreen Caliente

households.members: Flora Goodfellow, Pip Goodfellow, Dahlia Goodfellow, Fawn Goodfellow
households.caption: Fairies are typically curious about human Sims, and the Goodfellows are no exception. Led by their sprightly matriarch, Flora, the mischievous Goodfellows have engineered several encounters with humans, from simple pranks to elaborate social experiments! Their crowning achievement is an adoption mix-up resulting in Linda Rodgers' newly adopted baby being a fairy with the Goodfellows taking possession of the human baby instead. Will raising Fawn, their human toddler, bring them more than they bargained for?
households.key: Goodfellow family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Flora Goodfellow

households.members: James Hoppcraft, Miriam Hoppcraft, Alfred Hoppcraft
households.caption: Back where James Hoppcraft was from, people worked hard, respected one another, and didn't turn into howling beasts when the moon was full. And that's the way it should be everywhere. The Hoppcrafts are a traditional family that values traditional family values, period. Can the Hoppcrafts survive in such an outlandish town or will their values get the best of them?
households.key: Hoppcraft family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | James Hoppcraft

households.members: Rainflower Ivy, Annalove Ivy, Daydream Ivy, Peanut Ivy
households.caption: Once on the verge of living on the streets, the hippie Ivy family now lives the "trustifarian" lifestyle after Rainflower inherited a fortune from a long-lost great-aunt. No longer bound by the shackles of a budget, this family can have anything they'd like, except they don't know what they want! Will the influx of Simoleons be a curse for the Ivy family?
households.key: Ivy family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Rainflower Ivy

households.members: Flint MacDuff, Joanie MacDuff, Joe MacDuff, Jules MacDuff, Faith MacDuff, Felicity MacDuff, Unborn baby MacDuff
households.caption: This is one large family with another member on the way! To an outsider, this combined family of witches and humans may seem strange and full of chaos, but the MacDuffs are quick to pull together and support each other in a crisis (like that time Faith's hamster died…). The parents, Joanie and Flint, do their best to manage such a large household, but will the addition of Baby MacDuff be one MacDuff too many?
households.key: MacDuff family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Flint MacDuff

households.members: Mike Nix, Annie Nix, Mara Nix
households.caption: The Nix family may be the most “normal” family in Moonlight Falls…which makes them one of the most unusual families in Moonlight Falls! Mike and Annie met at a high school dance, dated through college, and then got married when Mike graduated from medical school. Mara was born a year later. Will the Nixes be able to find some friends or are they just too normal for a place like Moonlight Falls?
households.key: Nix family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | Mike Nix

households.members: David Pok, Janet Pok
households.caption: David Pok always had a thing for assertive women, but when the beautiful Janet slammed his head down onto the hood of her police cruiser he knew he had found The One. With careful planning, David ensured that Janet would be his arresting officer on his next heist. She read him his rights, he read her a love poem scribbled on a counterfeit bill, and the rest is history. Can Janet turn this love into a life sentence, or will she let David go early due to bad behavior?
households.name: Pok family
households.key: Pok family | The Sims 3: Supernatural | Moonlight Falls | David Pok

households.members: Linda Rodgers, Sophie Rodgers
households.caption: Linda Rodgers has more love in her pinky finger than some Sims have in their entire heart! households.caption: Elliott is a single parent, pet owner and full time employee of the workaholic Mikeal Clayton. Bronson offers some companionship, but does little to fill the relationship void in Elliott's life. Bradley is a bright and creative little boy, but is also very shy.
households.key: Lewis family | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Elliott Lewis

households.members: Stephen Loyal
households.caption: Stephen works as a chef at the renowned SimCity restaurant Julianne's. He tends to be set in his ways, but he's recently become open to more outside influence in his life.
households.key: Loyal family | The Sims Pet Stories | Mesa Flats | Stephen Loyal

households.members: Diva Loyal
households.caption: Diva loves being spoiled by Celeste, but also likes it when Stephen visits. Diva doesn't quite understand why Stephen is a bit aloof with her.
households.key: Loyal family | The Sims Pet Stories | Mesa Flats | Diva Loyal

households.members: Richard Martin, Maggie Martin
households.caption: Richard Martin is a retired dog show judge. After twenty years on the Sims Regional Pet Show circuit he decided to retire and buy a house in the community he grew to know and love. His dog Maggie is his pride and joy.
households.name: Martin family
households.key: Martin family (Garden Heights) | The Sims Pet Stories | Garden Heights | Richard Martin

households.members: Edmund Montez, Bailey Montez
households.caption: As a third-generation Montez, Edmund's roots run deep in Mesa Flats. He decided to buck the current trend of cat ownership by getting himself a Shiba Inu, Bailey.
households.key: Montez family | The Sims Pet Stories | Mesa Flats | Edmund Montez

households.members: Reece Mustella, Brock Thornton, Indie Thornton
households.caption: Brock and Reece are common street thugs who work for Diana DeBore as henchmen for hire. Brock is the muscle, while Reece is the brain. Brock is a victim of circumstance who took the only job he could find, working with Reece. Brock may look tough but is secretly quite the softie, especially when it comes to pets.
households.key: Mustella family | The Sims Pet Stories | Garden Heights | Reece Mustella

households.members: Shadow Rambler, Pooka Rambler
households.caption: Shadow and Pooka have been traveling with each other for a long time. They came to Mesa Flats to see if it really is the feline mecca they've heard about.
households.key: Rambler family | The Sims Pet Stories | Mesa Flats | Shadow Rambler

households.members: Zoey Rosenfeld, Baldur Rosenfeld, Tootsie Rosenfeld
households.caption: Zoey is very unique and she really loves both of her cats. Baldur and Tootsie get very jealous of anyone else that takes away any of Zoey's attention. Zoey often uses her cats as an excuse to avoid social situations.
households.key: Rosenfeld family | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Zoey Rosenfeld

households.members: Bernard Stanton, Venu Stanton, Brutus Stanton
households.caption: These roommates love to party. Brutus often feels neglected because of the active social lives of his masters.
households.key: Stanton family | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Bernard Stanton

households.members: Bridget Thedorff, Gracie Thedorff
households.caption: New to town, Bridget is single and ready to mingle. She’s looking for Mr. Right and Mr. Doggie Right for her beloved Gracie.
households.key: Thedorff family | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Bridget Thedorff

households.members: Johnny Tomasino, Doris Tomasino, Meatball Tomasino
households.caption: The Tomasinos are a close-knit family. They hardly live a life of luxury, but they make the best out of every situation. Meatball is completely spoiled as Doris and Johnny treat her like their child.
households.key: Tomasino family | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Johnny Tomasino

households.members: Alice Whitt, Sam Whitt
households.caption: Alice Whitt has inherited her grandparents' house. Recently she's moved back to Garden Heights to take ownership of the property, but money problems have put her on the verge of financial ruin. A starving artist, she hasn't been able to make ends meet every month, but she is determined to make a better life for herself and her dog Sam.
households.key: Whitt family | The Sims Pet Stories | Garden Heights | Alice Whitt

households.members: Veronica Williams, Savannah Williams
households.caption: Veronica and Savannah are sisters who compete at everything. They inherited a vast amount of wealth and spend the majority of their time chasing each others' love interests.
households.name: Williams family
households.key: Williams family (Arbor Falls) | The Sims Pet Stories | Arbor Falls | Veronica Williams

households.members: Sal Zugovich, Greta Zugovich
households.caption: Greta and Sal came to Mesa Flats years ago with two ambitions; to open a restaurant and a museum. These seemingly separate dreams met on the only available lot they could afford and became Sal's Bratwurst and Culture.
households.key: Zugovich family | The Sims Pet Stories | Mesa Flats | Sal Zugovich

households.members: Murray Barrett, Morag Barrett
households.caption: Murray's confusion between the terms "port" and "starboard" stranded the Barretts on Wanmami Island many years ago. In fact, the village elders say that Murray's ravings gave Wanmami its name. The Barretts had to give up the privateer's life to focus on daily survival instead, but they still love dressing up.
households.name: Barrett family
households.key: Barrett family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Wanmami Island | Murray Barrett

households.members: Birisi Folon, Mifune Folon
households.caption: The Folons have always been outsiders, wandering Wanmami Island at their whim. The villagers greet the Folons warmly each time they return, eagerly asking to hear about their discoveries and adventures in remote parts of the island.
households.name: Folon family
households.key: Folon family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Wanmami Island | Birisi Folon

households.members: Ahio Heimata, Rainui Heimata
households.caption: The Heimata family are among the most notable people on Felicity Island. Rainui is famous for her drama queen ways, and Ahio is famous for being able to put up with her.
households.key: Heimata family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Ahio Heimata

households.members: Kiri Roimata, Orama Herenui, Tumata Tehea
households.caption: By custom, the unattached women of the tribe live in huts in this jungle clearing. This fosters a sense of sharing and community, and makes lighter work out of daily living for all.
households.key: Herenui family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Kiri Roimata

households.members: Walter Lerner, Daniela Lerner, Nora Lerner, Danny Lerner
households.caption: The Lerners' story is a classic one of a holiday tour ending in a life-altering shipwreck. Now that all of the luxuries they took for granted are a distant memory, they'll have to learn to survive with nothing but the clothes on their backs and whatever else they can find. The kids may have some difficulties, but their parents rather enjoy the peace and quiet.
households.name: Lerner family
households.key: Lerner family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Wanmami Island | Walter Lerner

households.members: Fangaloka Manave, Huhana Manave, Nanihi Manave
households.caption: The Manave family are close-knit, loving, and easygoing, despite bearing the weight of leading the tribe. Luckily, Fangaloka has developed a good relationship with all known predators over the years.
households.key: Manave family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Fangaloka Manave

households.members: Joe Sim, Jane Sim
households.name: Sim family
households.key: Sim family (Castaway Stories) | The Sims Castaway Stories | Tutorial | Joe Sim

households.members: Robby Smith, Emma Langsford
households.caption: Much to their surprise, Robby and Emma found happiness on Felicity Island. Now that they've decided to stay, will they grow closer to one another or will they simply drive each other nuts?
households.name: Smith family
households.key: Smith family (Felicity Island) | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Robby Smith

households.members: Amanaki Tama, Urari Tama, Afi Mohea, Patariki Hina
households.caption: The Tamas were Felicity Island's shamans, herbalists, and all-round mystics. Amanaki Tama appointed a heroic outsider to succeed him as shaman, since no one in his own family was suited to take over the role.
households.key: Tama family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Amanaki Tama

households.members: Tuula Tiani, Baakir Tiani, Olabisi Tiani
households.caption: The widow Tuula lost her husband Gatimu when he tried to save a jaguar drowning in the ocean. Rather than withdraw after her husband's death, she stayed the open and warm person she always had been. Left to raise two children on her own, she loves to entertain visitors, but wonders if Linje Talani will ever come calling.
households.name: Tiani family
households.key: Tiani family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Wanmami Island | Tuula Tiani

households.members: Akolo Mamanu, Emobi Whetu, Timoti Fekitoa
households.caption: By custom, the unattached men of the tribe live together in this hut. The friendship they share as a group alleviates their individual loneliness... for now.
households.key: Whetu family | The Sims Castaway Stories | Felicity Island | Akolo Mamanu

households.members: Brady Branson, Brooke Branson, Brock Branson, Brimmy Branson, Molly Dalton
households.caption: Brady and Brooke seem to have the perfect marriage and family. He is a popular and respected journalist and she is the hometown sports star. Their son Brock seems to be following in his mother's footsteps and is an accomplished angler. Yes, life is good! But can this ideal family survive Molly, Brooke's crazy aunt, moving in? Brooke invited her to visit and now she seems like she's here to stay. Brady puts on a good face but Molly's antics are certainly wearing him down.
households.key: Branson family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Brady Branson

households.members: Mark Chin, Haley Chin, Sally Chin, Hammy Chin
households.caption: Neighbors refer to the Chins as eccentric, sometimes rude and even a bit snobby, and Haley is all of those, if not more. Mark, on the other hand, is a really nice easy going guy and is weary of apologizing for his wife's behavior. Thankfully their daughter Sally appears to have much more of his personality, rather than her mother's.
households.name: Chin family
households.key: Chin family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Mark Chin

households.members: Robert Dakota, Carolina Dakota, Scout Dakota, Bean Dakota, Willy Dakota
households.caption: If it were up to Robert Dakota he would have named his twins North and South. This is just one example of his quirky and often silly sense of humor, and his parenting has resulted in a couple of odd teenagers. Carolina is the rock of the family; what she says goes, though she would never disagree with her husband in front of the twins.
households.name: Dakota family
households.key: Dakota family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Robert Dakota

households.members: Holden Donlan, Gwen Donlan, Tom Donlan
households.caption: The Donlans have deep roots in the town and surrounding area; they can trace their lineage nearly back to the founding of the town. Holden is an eager young journalist with a knack for uncovering unorthodox human interest stories, and Gwen is Holden's pretty young wife. She takes part-time jobs to help with the family income, but would one day like to make painting her career.
households.key: Donlan family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Holden Donlan

households.members: Zachariah Dungworth, Eleanor Dungworth
households.caption: The Dungworth's are not known well around town. Eleanor has been making some attempt to enter the dating pool as of late, with mixed results. Those few who do know her describe her as excitable, inappropriate and overall odd. Her father Zachariah is truly an enigma. It is clear he is wealthy, but how he came by his money no one seems to know.
households.key: Dungworth family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Zachariah Dungworth

households.members: Marley Esker, Aimee Esker, Sandy Esker, Grit Esker
households.caption: The Eskers are new to the community and looking forward to make friends. Marley has put his career on hold to follow his dream of becoming an artist. His wife Aimee is good with that decision and is supporting the family only on her income for now. However she has made it clear she would like another baby, and soon!
households.key: Esker family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Marley Esker

households.members: Marcel Gattus, Austin Gattus
households.key: Gattus family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Marcel Gattus

households.members: Johnstone Gilman, Vincent Gilman, Catherine Gilman, Eva Gilman, K8 Gilman
households.caption: The Gilman family is the richest in town. They are also the oldest family in the area, with an unbroken line of descendants going back to when the town was known as Gilman Hill. The elderly Johnstone recently passed on the running of the family company to his son Vincent and now spends his days doting on his new granddaughter. Vincent and his wife find themselves overworked at times between the pressures of careers and a new child.
households.connect: Branson family, Dalton family, Goth family
households.key: Gilman family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Johnstone Gilman

households.members: Geri Tolben, Mary Kendall, Kelly Kendall, Ali Tolben, Zola Kendall
households.caption: When Merry and her daughter moved in with family friend Geri they had no idea how much fun they would end up having. Even the cats seem to get along... usually.
households.key: Girl's Club family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Geri Tolben

households.members: Dorin Fugue, Jean Grayson, Randolph Grayson, Janis Grayson, Sumo Grayson
households.caption: Dorin and Jean moved to the area because he wanted to live on the coast and she wanted to live in a small town. They both got their wish! The kids are less pleased, especially hot-headed Janis, but Sumo, the loyal family dog, seems to like the new neighborhood and might just bring them around with his sweet demeanor.
households.key: Grayson family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Dorin Fugue

households.members: Pablo Hernandez, Jennifer Hernandez, Jewelsy Hernandez
households.caption: Jennifer and Pablo have been married several years now. They both love the outdoors and enjoy going hiking or taking their little dog Jewelsy out to see one of the many parks around town. They're the friendliest people in town, and are always hosting the best parties!
households.name: Hernandez family
households.key: Hernandez family (Sugar Maple Coast) | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Pablo Hernandez

households.members: Deacon Hunter, Daria Hunter, Ghost Hunter
households.caption: Deacon and Daria met while hiking and it didn't take long for them to strike up a conversation. Two dates later they were talking about marriage, and discussing where to retire by the end of the fourth date. Now they're married and settling in to life in Sugar Maple Coast: they still go hiking regularly, and always with Daria's faithful dog Ghost, but they're looking for a new adventure to take on together.
households.name: Hunter family
households.key: Hunter family (Sugar Maple Coast) | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Deacon Hunter

households.members: Alonzo Justice, Stacie Justice, Jimmy Justice, Prince Justice, Mia Justice
households.caption: Athena has her hands full balancing a large family and a fulltime career. She wishes her husband would calm down and help out, but he's so neurotic that he's always finding something to worry about; he says he likes it in this town, but she knows he still misses Riverview. The kids are doing well at least: Jimmy's teenage years are turning out to be surprisingly easy and Prince is a cute little guy, if a little strange at times. At least she has Mia, her adorable cat, to help calm her nerves.
households.key: Justice family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Alonzo Justice

households.members: Andrew Kingsley, Jo Kingsley, Andy Kingsley, Carla Kingsley, Pennington Kingsley
households.caption: Andrew has done very well as a businessman over the years, while his wife Jo has quickly risen through the ranks of law enforcement. Andrew is the perfectionist's perfectionist. This has been great for his career, but not so much when it comes to his family. His wife has grown used to his ways over the years. However, the kids chafe from his need for everthing to be perfect. Andrew particularly worries for his teenage son Andy, who seems to want to do nothing but play Planet of SimCraft.
households.key: Kingsley family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Andrew Kingsley

households.members: Paul Ortiz, Kelley Ortiz
households.caption: When Paul agreed to take on raising his troublesome teenage granddaughter Sandra, he had no idea it would be so challenging! When her mom dropped her off, she was unruly, self-centered, and disrespectful. They've had a number of rough times, but Paul's firm but fair manner might just win her over...
households.key: Ortiz & Soto family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Paul Ortiz

households.members: Jackson Rattlebag, Buttercup Rattlebag
households.key: Rattlebag family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Jackson Rattlebag

households.members: Norio Soon, Akimi Soon, Anzu Soon, Susumu Soon
households.caption: Norio is a serious man, and works hard to keep his family cared for. He hates frivolity, which is unfortunate for his wife Akimi; she loves to have fun, host parties, and meet new people... She really can't figure out why her husband is glued to a laptop all day. Luckily she has the dogs to play with when Norio works too much!
households.key: Soon family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Norio Soon

households.members: Blake Simmons, Jeremy Stone, Gianna Rios, Muffin Simmons, Trinket Rios
households.caption: No one is quite sure what "GDL" stands for. Most likely it has something to do with computers, knowing Blake and Jeremy. The two have been best friends since childhood, but lately Jeremy has changed after his new girlfriend, Gianna, moved in. Blake plays nice, but he doesn't approve of the new arrangement. How will he get his old friend back?
households.key: The GDL family | The Sims 3: Pets (console) | Sugar Maple Coast | Blake Simmons
